title: the importance of home life - cottage crafting vlog
en: hello everyone today i wanted to share a little bit about how i imbue a sense of whimsy for lack of a better word into many aspects of my home and life as you can see my cottage is alternative in its style and i would say rather unusual in comparison to more mainstream home decor however to strictly speak on the practicalities of transforming this room i think would miss a lot of my philosophy behind
creating a space in which you feel welcomed and accepted no matter who you are uh oh

do to explain my philosophy i must begin by asking you a question have you ever listened to a beautiful song that has touched your soul so deeply that it almost hurts when it's over maybe you've experienced this when you've watched an incredibly poignant scene in your favorite movie read an atmospheric book that transported you to another world

or maybe simply the feeling of being utterly and completely enraptured by the beauty of whatever it is you have just experienced i think as children it happens more often since we're still new to the world and all its fascinating elements i remember seeing a butterfly wing under a microscope for the first time when i was and gasped at the stunning intricacy and other worldliness of the design since then i've loved butterflies and you can always spot some in my room as we become adults it can be easy to go in and day out without having moments like these i have again discovered a love of daily life through reclaiming the curiosity and daydreaming of my youth
and this has impacted how i decorate and the crafts that i make okay hmm i know not everyone cares to recreate a

sense of wonder and surrealism within their living space also maybe you can't relate to this at all and i'm sounding a little odd right now it is okay i'm used to it anyway i would love to know your thoughts my reason for speaking on this is because i've designed my space in a way to remind me of those precious and beautiful whimsical moments i wish i could hang on to forever i love adding little details and cutouts my favorite books painting the walls making things by hand i'm well aware i cannot live in a fantasy world and i wouldn't wish to however having a dreamy space that makes me feel calm creative and imaginative gives me strength to deal with the world on days when things seem overly negative or scary

you can see this philosophy directly impacting these videos they are creative outlets an artistic take on home life that sees things as i said once before not as they are all the time but maybe how they could be i love to emphasize the beauty of plants art and sunlight through these videos but i'm not able to stay in the present

all the time and enjoy these things to the fullest that is why i love to make these videos and re-center through the process it forces me to slow down and remember what's important life can be beautiful and meaningful not only through its achievements but in its simplest moments let me know your perspectives on home life and how you create a space that gives you comfort because i think that's what many of us are looking for a haven that draws us in and gives us a sense of safety i feel

embraced by my home because i've put so much time into it so many handmade items and details if i'm ever overwhelmed or filled with worry i like to walk into this room and take a deep breath and remind myself that i am safe sending you hugs wherever you are you
zh: 大家好，今天我想分享一些关于我如何将一种奇思怪想的感觉融入到我的家和生活的许多方面，因为你可以看到我的小屋在风格上是另类的，我想说与更主流的家居装饰相比相当不寻常，但是严格来说改造这个房间的实用性我认为会错过我背后的很多哲学
创造一个让你感到受欢迎和被接受的空间，无论你是谁
为了解释我的哲学，我必须首先问你一个问题，你是否听过一首美妙的歌曲，它如此深刻地触动你的灵魂，以至于结束时几乎会受伤，也许你在观看你最喜欢的电影中令人难以置信的辛酸场景时经历过这种情况，读过一本将你带到另一个世界的大气书籍
或者也许只是一种完全被你刚刚经历过的美丽所迷住的感觉，我想，作为孩子，这种情况更常见，因为我们对这个世界及其所有迷人的元素还很陌生，我记得第一次在显微镜下看到蝴蝶的翅膀，当时我对设计的令人惊叹的复杂性和其他世俗性感到惊叹，从那时起我就喜欢蝴蝶，你总能在我的房间里发现一些蝴蝶，当我们长大后，可以很容易地进出一天，而没有时间。像这样，我通过找回年轻时的好奇心和白日梦，再次发现了对日常生活的热爱
这影响了我的装饰方式和我制作的工艺品，嗯，我知道不是每个人都愿意重新创造一个

他们的生活空间中的惊奇感和超现实主义也许你根本无法理解这一点，我现在听起来有点奇怪，没关系，我已经习惯了，无论如何，我很想知道你的想法，我之所以谈论这个，是因为我设计我的空间的方式是为了提醒我那些珍贵而美丽的异想天开的时刻，我希望我能永远坚持下去，我喜欢添加小细节和剪纸，我最喜欢的书，粉刷墙壁，手工制作东西，我很清楚我不能生活在幻想中世界，我不希望拥有一个梦幻般的空间，让我感到平静，富有创造力和想象力，让我有力量在事情看起来过于消极或可怕的日子里应对世界
你可以看到这种哲学直接影响了这些视频，它们是对家庭生活的创意渠道，一种对家庭生活的艺术诠释，就像我之前说过的那样，而不是一直如此，但也许它们是如何的，我喜欢通过这些视频强调植物艺术和阳光的美丽，但我无法停留在当下
一直并充分享受这些事情，这就是为什么我喜欢制作这些视频并在整个过程中重新集中注意力，它迫使我放慢速度并记住什么是重要的生活不仅可以通过其成就而且可以在最简单的时刻变得美丽和有意义，让我知道您对家庭生活的看法以及您如何创建一个让您感到舒适的空间，因为我认为这就是我们许多人正在寻找一个吸引我们并给我们安全感的避风港。
被我的家拥抱，因为我投入了这么多的时间，这么多的手工制品和细节，如果我不知所措或充满担忧，我喜欢走进这个房间，深呼吸，提醒自己，无论你在哪里，我都会安全地拥抱你
